parsed.summary: The PR improves consistency and readability by using BoundField objects, but it lacks a method like bf._did_change() in the proposed changes.

issues.description: The proposed changes do not include a method like bf._did_change() in the BoundField class, which is mentioned as part of the improvement. This could lead to maintainability issues.
